title: The 3 Best Electric Can Openers Under $50
h1: The 3 Best Electric Can Openers Under $50
metaDescription: Our 3 picks for electric can openers under $50, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at electric can openers under $50 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Cuisinart Deluxe Electric Can Opener CCO-50N
products.blurb: Key specs: Typically $35 to $45, Single-touch automatic operation, Automatic stop.
strengths: Automatic stop is the single most useful upgrade over budget models in this price bracket
Nonslip base and detachable lever are genuine, usable upgrades, not just marketing
limitations: Not rated for extra-tall can capacity the way the Hamilton Beach is
Bulkier footprint than a compact cordless model
Fewer total reviews than the Hamilton Beach or Kitchen Mama

products.name: Black+Decker Spacemaker EC600 Can Opener
products.blurb: Key specs: Typically $45 to $55, Under-cabinet mounting, One-touch lever.
strengths: Only pick in this price range that mounts fixed and permanently frees the counter
One-touch lever operation is consistent once installed
Built-in cord wrap keeps the mounted unit tidy
limitations: Requires a one-time installation most other picks don't
Smallest review base of the picks in this category

products.name: Hamilton Beach Smooth Touch Electric Can Opener
products.blurb: Key specs: Typically $25 to $30, Push-down lever, Extra-tall opening.
strengths: Bundled scissors are a genuinely useful extra at this price
limitations: No automatic stop, unlike the Cuisinart
Basic finish compared to pricier competitors

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
